chronology_note: Same audit as E0482 (party_vr96_b); two reachable legends (Chi-Yu, Landorus), no window-90 addition used.

Sceptile / Mega Greninja Protean fast mixed mode
Aegislash Stance Change + King's Shield + Weakness Policy

attempts.party: party_vr96_b.json led by Whimsicott + Mega Kangaskhan
attempts.why: Turn 1 Jynx's faster Fake Out flinched Whimsicott before its Prankster Taunt; Kangaskhan's Fake Out broke Jynx's Sash; Xerneas chose Moonblast (Fairy Aura) and OHKO'd Whimsicott. Turn 2 Xerneas Protected the Double-Edge + Heat Wave; Jynx Ice Beam 174 on Kangaskhan, Heat Wave KO'd Jynx. Turn 3 Overheat + Double-Edge KO'd Xerneas (it chose Moonblast again, never Geomancy); Sceptile's Leaf Storm missed. Turn 4 Double-Edge OHKO'd Sceptile, Duraludon Draco Meteor KO'd Kangaskhan. Turn 5 Mega Greninja Protean Ice Beam 4x OHKO'd Landorus; Close Combat took Duraludon to 69. Turn 6 Greninja Protected (Unseen Fist quarter went through for 119). Turn 7 Close Combat KO'd Duraludon, Flare Blitz KO'd the now-Ice Greninja. Turn 8 Aegislash Shadow Sneak KO'd Urshifu (118, -3 Def); Parting Shot -1/-1. Turn 9 King's Shield blocked Dark Pulse + Flare Blitz (Incineroar -1 Atk). Turn 10 Dark Pulse OHKO'd Aegislash in Shield Forme (Weakness Policy irrelevant because it died). Faints: Whimsicott, Kangaskhan, Landorus, Urshifu.

strategy_checks.evidence: turn 1 Fake Out flinched Whimsicott (the Taunt user) before Prankster Taunt could resolve

Xerneas' three turns: Moonblast (KO), Protect, Moonblast. With Power Herb held and a Sash-less Kangaskhan opposite, it never once set up; the dossier's 'single most dangerous turn in Victory Road' did not exist
turn 5 Mega Evolved, Ice Beam changed type and 4x OHKO'd Landorus; Sceptile missed Leaf Storm twice then died
Draco Meteor KO'd Kangaskhan turn 4; survived Close Combat at 69

strategy_checks.check: Aegislash Stance Change / King's Shield / Weakness Policy
strategy_checks.result: PASS (stance, King's Shield), Policy never fired
strategy_checks.evidence: Shadow Sneak KO turn 8 (Blade), King's Shield turn 9 returned it to Shield and dropped Incineroar's Attack; OHKO'd turn 10 before the Policy mattered

protect_ledger.payoff: blocked Double-Edge + Heat Wave (~480, lethal) - good
blocked Fake Out; Close Combat still did 119 through it (Unseen Fist, by design) - fair
blocked lethal Dark Pulse + Flare Blitz and dropped Incineroar's Attack - good, delay only

ai_defects.board: Xerneas 378/378 with Power Herb beside Jynx, facing Whimsicott (Sash) + Kangaskhan, later Chi-Yu + Kangaskhan
ai_defects.better: Geomancy (instant with Power Herb: +2 SpA/SpD/Spe). The turn-1 Moonblast KO on Whimsicott is defensible, but on turn 3 at full HP with no KO available (Kangaskhan 164, Chi-Yu 242 full) it attacked again and was OHKO'd. The authored plan's centrepiece never fired; the setup scoring should value a Power Herb Geomancy far above a non-lethal Moonblast.

ai_notes: Aegislash's Shadow Sneak into a 118-HP Urshifu and its King's Shield timing were both right. Greninja Protecting on the Fake Out turn was a good read.
level_change_rationale: Won first try 6-4 after the hardest fight of the block. Keep. The team is at the right tier even with its ace playing wrong.
cooler: The gate is correct and, if Geomancy ever fires, ferocious. The one piece of the design that did not matter was the Weakness Policy: the player can simply never hit Shield Forme super-effectively and take it in one Blade-Forme hit. No set change; fix the Geomancy scoring first.
